title: Details and care
subtitle: Review your child's details and booked care. Changes that require approval are clearly marked.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.body: A change could not be saved. If you leave this page, it will be lost.

healthDirectHint: Changes are saved directly. The OGS team sees the information immediately.
healthPlaceholder: For example allergies, intolerances or important medication.
dataDescription: Personal details, class and important health information.
identityDescription: These details can only be changed after review by the OGS.
requestHint: These changes are reviewed by the team before they are applied.
departureDescription: Choose whether your child is picked up, walks home alone or takes the bus on each weekday. The OGS reviews changes.
departureReadOnlyAccompanied: Your child goes home with another child on at least one day. You cannot change the way home here.
departurePendingNotice: The OGS is reviewing your change. Until it is confirmed, the current way home applies.
requestSubmitted: Request sent. The team will review your change.
editDisabled: Editing these details is disabled for this OGS.
requestDisabled: Change requests are disabled for this OGS.

identityModal.title: Change personal details
identityModal.intro: Only change details that are no longer correct.
identityModal.noticeBody: The OGS reviews your request. The current details remain valid until it is approved.
identityModal.noChange: Please change at least one detail.
identityModal.required: A changed detail must not be empty.

careOfferings.hint: This care is booked for your child. Changes are reviewed by the team before they apply.
careOfferings.offeringsDescription: See further details about care, such as lunch or holiday care.
careOfferings.noOfferings: No care has currently been selected for {name}.
careOfferings.scheduleOnlyDescription: {name} attends OGS at the times shown above. No further booking details are available.
careOfferings.pendingNotice: Your request is being reviewed by the team. Everything stays as it is until it is confirmed.
careOfferings.disabledNoEnrollment: No further care details are available for {name}.
careOfferings.disabledNoPermission: You are not allowed to request changes for this child.
careOfferings.disabledSchoolOff: This care team does not accept change requests through the app. Please contact them directly.
careOfferings.disabledPeriodOver: The care period has ended. Please enrol your child again for the new period.
careOfferings.withdrawalApprovedHint: The school will complete the withdrawal. You do not need to do anything.
careOfferings.decisionReason: Reason given by the care team: {reason}
careOfferings.noRequests: There is no change request at the moment.
careOfferings.decisionOverridden: The care team did not book {names}.

careOfferingsModal.title: Change booked care
careOfferingsModal.editIntro: Change your open request. Your new selection replaces the previous request.
careOfferingsModal.noteRequired: Please say briefly why the care should change.
careOfferingsModal.staleError: The request has changed in the meantime. Please reload the page.
careOfferingsModal.intro: Choose which offerings your child should attend and when the change should take effect. The team reviews your request.
careOfferingsModal.noOfferings: No care can be booked for this period.
careOfferingsModal.effectiveFromHint: Earliest {date}. Please select a date within an approved care period.
careOfferingsModal.notePlaceholder: For example the reason for the change.
careOfferingsModal.noChange: Your selection matches the current booking. Change something to send a request.
careOfferingsModal.noDaysSelected: Pick at least one day for every selected offering.
careOfferingsModal.dayConflict: {day}: {offerings} are selected. Please choose only one offer per day.
careOfferingsModal.capacityFull: One of the selected offerings has no places left. Please choose another offering or contact the school.
careOfferingsModal.alreadyPending: There is already a request for your child. Please wait for it to be reviewed.
careOfferingsModal.withdrawalConfirmBody: After this, {name} will have no booked care day. Do you really want to send this request?

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: Courses at the OGS. A request only counts once the OGS confirms it.
courses.careEnded: Care has ended. Please contact the OGS.
courses.noSubmitPermission: You cannot send a request. Please contact the OGS.
courses.fullWaitlistHint: Full. A request goes on the waiting list.
courses.effectiveFrom: A course can start on {date} at the earliest.
courses.otherRequest: You already have an open request about care. Please wait for the answer.
courses.needsEnrollment: You can request courses once your child is registered.
courses.noCourses: There are no courses at the moment.
courses.errorObjectWithdraw: the withdrawal of the course request

careSchedule.readOnlyNotice: You cannot change the weekly plan here. Changes to booked offerings are in the next section.
careSchedule.noPermissionNotice: You cannot request changes here. Please ask your OGS.
careSchedule.requestIntro: Change care days, pick-up times, or ways home. You only see changes your OGS allows.
careSchedule.requestNoticeBody: This is a permanent change that applies every week. The OGS reviews your request. Your current weekly schedule remains valid until it is approved.
careSchedule.requestNoChange: Change at least one care day, pick-up time, or way home.
careSchedule.requestMissingPlan: Choose a pick-up time and way home for new care days.
careSchedule.requestAlreadyPending: A change for this child is already being reviewed.
careSchedule.requestDisabled: This change is not enabled by your OGS.
careSchedule.requestBookingLed: Your OGS does not accept weekly plan requests. Changes go through the booked offerings.
careSchedule.pendingNotice: The OGS is reviewing the change. The current weekly plan remains valid until it is approved.

errorNoEnrollment: Your child no longer has a valid enrollment. Please contact the school.
